why: Root cause found and fixed: harness-config's profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml restated the connection row's whole config and dropped trustedHosts: !!js ctx.webRuntime.trustedHosts, the only source of the /api browser-trust fence's trusted authorities. Measured with two scratch engines, same build and flags, one file different: POST /api/agentPresets/list with Host=<authority> returned 403 forbidden with the patch and 401 unauthorized without it; the fixed engine's authenticated round trip returns 200. Commits 25ab7bf (fix), fe8396a (probe checks 13/14 so this class is visible). Probe now 15/15. Corrects L152b.

Cause found and fixed. The gate was not dying from anything about the browser or the request load: it was dying when the SSH session that started it ended. /proc/<gate>/cgroup showed 0::/user.slice/user-1000.slice/session-25033.scope, and the journal shows 'Session 25028 logged out. Waiting for processes to exit.' followed by 'Removed session 25028.' ten seconds later. setsid nohup detaches a terminal but does NOT move a process out of its cgroup, and systemd-logind reaps a session scope's processes when the session ends - so the engine, the gate and the redirector were each living in a different transient login session. A signal leaves nothing in the process's own log, which is why there were zero tracebacks and no OOM line, and why the symptom looked like 'it dies when a browser loads the page': the browser failure is where the death became visible. Fixed by making both long-lived processes systemd units (phone-engine.service, phone-gate.service, Restart=always, 2-3s, LimitNOFILE=8192) in /system.slice/, where no login can reap them, and by making serve-phone.sh defer to them rather than start its own. Three outages preceded the fix; probe returned to 15/15 with the units owning the ports.
